title: Targeted Modification of a Novel Amphibian Antimicrobial Peptide from Phyllomedusa tarsius to Enhance Its Activity against MRSA and Microbial Biofilm.

supplementary_assets.text_summary: OOXML supplement contains supplementary figure captions for precursor/model validation; no recoverable spreadsheet/table activity values were present.

materials_exhausted.note: Local XML/NXML, PDF text, OA package, OOXML supplement, and linked database snapshots were opened. Remaining caveats are representational conflicts, not blocking missing material.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP row-level assays and literature links are source-verified against XML Tables 1-3 and article metadata; CAMP/dbAMP entry-text summaries are preserved as source_conflict and not promoted to primary rows.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 repair extracted all source-supported MIC/MBC, HC50, MBIC, and MBEC rows from XML Tables 2 and 3 with units, targets, and method locators; the prior Table 3 parser blocker is closed.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Worker-6 retained only source-located mechanism/phenotype claims: antibiofilm phenotype, structure-design context, and limited direct DNA-leakage evidence for medusin-PT2 at high concentration.
per_layer_decision_rationale.adjudication: No blocking or major rework target remains after bounded local recovery; acceptance is with cautions because database-summary rows and one source-only MBEC value remain representational caveats.

caution_findings.evidence_context: CAMP/dbAMP entry-text rows were checked but remain source_conflict summaries because they are not row-granular primary assay observations and one dbAMP row combines medusin-PT1/PT1a.
XML Table 3 supports medusin-PT1a MBEC 64 μg/mL; linked DBAASP assay rows did not include the corresponding MBEC row, so it remains source-only.
The E. coli medusin-PT2 MIC/MBC table cell appears as >512>512 in NXML; the pair is preserved as separate >512 MIC and >512 MBC with a parse note.
DataSheet1.docx was opened via OOXML and contains supplementary figure material, not additional activity/toxicity tables.

adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed rework repaired the Table 3 activity blocker, replaced incorrect HC50-as-MBC rows, reconciled DBAASP row-level assays to primary XML tables, preserved non-row database summaries as cautions, and closed the single rework ticket as accepted_with_cautions.
